data.name: Titanite
data.detailed_description:
♦ Battle and Tame Mechas ♦

Rogue Mechas once ruled the wilds, but now we fight back. Override their systems, seize control, and upgrade them into powerful war machines. From heavy siege units to agile fliers and resource harvesting rigs, each Mecha brings unique power to your fight for survival. Industrial types turbocharge your gathering, mobility units let you blaze across the wasteland at breakneck speed, and combat Mechas bring devastating firepower to suppress enemies and demolish fortifications. In a world shaped by steel and chaos, those who command the Mechas will rise.

♦ Two Worlds, Your Move ♦

Our revolutionary Dual-World system splits survival into two distinct realities. Drop into the Warzone where high-risk PvP means high-reward loot—take down rival survivors and steal everything they carry, but one death costs you the whole haul. Then teleport your spoils back to your Base World, a completely safe zone where you trade on the open market, upgrade your gear, and plan your next run. Risk it all for the big score or grind safe and steady? Your strategy, your survival.

♦ Explore, Build, and Defend Your Legacy ♦

Construct your base anywhere in your Base World, fortify it with walls and defensive turrets, and store your hard-earned loot. But survival isn't just about defense—team up with friends to design everything from a crude shelter to a sprawling steel fortress with automated defenses. Your base is your kingdom. Build it smart, or watch it burn.

♦ Dominate with Advanced Firearms and Tactical Combat ♦

Combat in the wild isn't just about firepower—it's about how you move, react, and strike. Combine unique firearms with tactical jetpacks for true three-dimensional warfare: hover above the chaos, dash through enemy fire, and deploy instant cover mid-fight for seamless attack and defense. Choose from a vast arsenal of weapons, each with distinct handling, attachments, and even unique abilities. Some high-tier guns come with built-in tech skills that can turn the tide of battle in an instant. With deep team tactics and high-skill mechanics, every firefight is a test of reflexes and coordination. Skill sets your ceiling. Teamwork seals the win.

data.short_description: Titanite is a post-apocalyptic Mecha survival game blending free-form building with competitive PvP. Command powerful Mechas, navigate the deadly Warzone, and retreat to the safety of your Base World. Forge your own survival rules through strategy and gunfire!
